## Initialize Database

We use DuckDB for all spatial operations to avoid loading millions of geometries into R memory.
Every processed layer is already in EPSG:26912 (UTM 12N), so no layer is reprojected here;
only the H3 lookups need lat/lon, and those use a WGS84 copy of each centroid.

DuckDB is given an explicit budget so it cannot take the whole machine. The values below
were sized from this workstation (95.7 GB RAM, about 66 GB free at the time, 20 logical
cores): 40 GB for DuckDB leaves roughly 25 GB for R/Positron, the ORS container and the OS,
and 12 threads leave cores free. Anything past the memory limit spills to `.tmp/duckdb`
instead of crashing. Adjust these two numbers on a different machine.

```{r}
#| label: init-db
DUCKDB_MEMORY <- "40GB"
DUCKDB_THREADS <- 12L

# In-memory database: every table is rebuilt from the parquet layers on each run.
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "SET geometry_always_xy = true")
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;")

fp_spill <- here::here(".tmp", "duckdb")
fs::dir_create(fp_spill)
DBI::dbExecute(conn, glue::glue("SET memory_limit = '{DUCKDB_MEMORY}'"))
DBI::dbExecute(conn, glue::glue("SET threads = {DUCKDB_THREADS}"))
DBI::dbExecute(conn, glue::glue("SET temp_directory = '{fp_spill}'"))
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "SET max_temp_directory_size = '200GB'")
```

# Part 1: Prepare Targets (The Canvas)

We start by loading the Parcels and H3 grids. We immediately join Administrative and Building attributes so our "Canvas" is fully described before we start painting it with amenities.

Check Desired format here: https://services1.arcgis.com/taguadKoI1XFwivx/arcgis/rest/services/HousingSuitability_Centers2025_gdb/FeatureServer/0

## Load H3 Grid

We load H3 first to get the resolution, then use that resolution to load Parcels with the correct H3 index pre-calculated.

```{r}
#| label: load-h3
fp_h3_grid <- here::here(sub_dirs$base, "Analysis_Boundary_H3_Grid.parquet")

# 1. Load Polygons (already UTM). h3_index is the unique key of this table.
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue(
    "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE targets_h3 AS
  SELECT
    CAST(h3_index AS UBIGINT) as h3_index, -- Strict type safety
    geometry as geom
  FROM read_parquet('{fp_h3_grid}')
"
  )
)

# 2. One point per cell. No indexes: DuckDB's spatial join builds its own.
message("📍 Pre-calculating H3 Points (Centroid)...")
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE points_h3 AS
  SELECT h3_index, ST_Centroid(geom) as geom
  FROM targets_h3
"
)

message("✅ H3 Grid loaded")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. GET RESOLUTION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# We need this 'res' variable for the next steps
res <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  conn,
  "SELECT h3_get_resolution(h3_index) as res FROM targets_h3 LIMIT 1"
)$res
message(glue::glue("ℹ️ Detected Grid Resolution: {res}"))
```

## Load Parcels

```{r}
#| label: load-parcels
fp_remm_parcels <- here::here(sub_dirs$parcels, "REMM_BY_parcels.parquet")

# 1. Load Polygons (already UTM). parcel_id is the unique key of this table.
#    H3 needs lat/lon, so the index comes from a WGS84 copy of the centroid.
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue(
    "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE targets_parcels AS
  SELECT
    parcel_id,
    CAST(h3_latlng_to_cell(ST_Y(c), ST_X(c), {res}) AS UBIGINT) as h3_index,
    geom
  FROM (
    SELECT
      parcel_id,
      ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry), '{CRS_WGS}') as c,
      ST_MakeValid(geometry) as geom
    FROM read_parquet('{fp_remm_parcels}')
    WHERE ST_IsValid(geometry)
  )
"
  )
)

# 2. One point per parcel (Point-On-Surface).
#    ST_PointOnSurface guarantees the point is INSIDE the polygon (unlike Centroid).
#    This handles U-shaped parcels correctly.
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE points_parcels AS
  SELECT parcel_id, ST_PointOnSurface(geom) as geom
  FROM targets_parcels
"
)

message("✅ Parcels loaded")
```

# Part 2: Static Attributes (Admin & Land Use)

## Attach Administrative Data

A helper function to join City/County codes to any target table (Parcel or H3).

```{r}
#| label: func-admin-join
attach_admin_data <- function(conn, target_table, point_table, key) {
  message(glue::glue("🏛️ Attaching Admin Data to {target_table}..."))
  fp_municipal_bound <- here::here(
    sub_dirs$base,
    "UtahMunicipalBoundaries.parquet"
  )
  fp_county_bound <- here::here(sub_dirs$base, "UtahCountyBoundaries.parquet")

  # 1. Load Admin Layers (Fixed Geometry)
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE layer_muni AS
    SELECT
      ugrcode as CommCode,
      geometry as geom
    FROM read_parquet('{fp_municipal_bound}')
  "
    )
  )

  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE layer_county AS
    SELECT
      countynbr as COUNTYNBR,
      geometry as geom
    FROM read_parquet('{fp_county_bound}')
  "
    )
  )

  # 2. Add Columns
  for (col in c("CommCode", "COUNTYNBR")) {
    DBI::dbExecute(
      conn,
      glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS {col}")
    )
    DBI::dbExecute(
      conn,
      glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} ADD COLUMN {col} VARCHAR")
    )
  }

  # 3. Update City (Spatial Join on Point Table -> Update Target by key)
  #    GROUP BY keeps one row per point if it sits exactly on a shared border.
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    UPDATE {target_table}
    SET CommCode = match.CommCode
    FROM (
        SELECT pt.{key}, MIN(m.CommCode) as CommCode
        FROM {point_table} pt
        JOIN layer_muni m ON ST_Intersects(pt.geom, m.geom)
        GROUP BY pt.{key}
    ) match
    WHERE {target_table}.{key} = match.{key}
  "
    )
  )

  # 4. Update County (Spatial Join on Point Table -> Update Target by key)
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    UPDATE {target_table}
    SET COUNTYNBR = match.COUNTYNBR
    FROM (
        SELECT pt.{key}, MIN(c.COUNTYNBR) as COUNTYNBR
        FROM {point_table} pt
        JOIN layer_county c ON ST_Intersects(pt.geom, c.geom)
        GROUP BY pt.{key}
    ) match
    WHERE {target_table}.{key} = match.{key}
  "
    )
  )

  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "DROP TABLE layer_muni; DROP TABLE layer_county;")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-admin-join
# Pass the pre-calculated point tables we created in Part 1
attach_admin_data(conn, "targets_parcels", "points_parcels", "parcel_id")
attach_admin_data(conn, "targets_h3", "points_h3", "h3_index")
```

## Building Codes (BC)

We join the REMM buildings table. Since `building_type` contains full strings (e.g., "Single Family Res"), we create a mapping table to translate them to abbreviations (e.g., "SF").

```{r}
#| label: building-codes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load Buildings & Store as UTM (Projected)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("🏗️ Loading Building Centroids (Spatial)...")

fp_remm_buildings <- here::here(sub_dirs$parcels, "REMM_BY_buildings.parquet")

# Create Temp Table with BOTH UTM Geom and H3 Index
# Load -> Centroid -> Transform (UTM) -> Index
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue(
    "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE points_buildings AS
  SELECT
    parcel_id,
    building_type,
    building_sqft,

    -- 1. H3 Index (Integer Match), from a WGS84 copy of the centroid
    CAST(h3_latlng_to_cell(
      ST_Y(ST_Transform(geom, '{CRS_WGS}')),
      ST_X(ST_Transform(geom, '{CRS_WGS}')),
      {res}
    ) AS UBIGINT) as h3_index,

    -- 2. UTM Geometry
    geom

  FROM (
    SELECT parcel_id, building_type, building_sqft, ST_Centroid(geometry) as geom
    FROM read_parquet('{fp_remm_buildings}')
    WHERE ST_IsValid(geometry)
  )
"
  )
)

# Create Mapping Table (Full Name -> Abbreviation)
bc_mapping <- tibble::tribble(
  ~full_name                 , ~abbr ,
  "Agriculture"              , "AG"  ,
  "Church"                   , "CH"  ,
  "Commons"                  , "OS"  ,
  "Educational"              , "ED"  ,
  "Empty - Buildable"        , "EM"  ,
  "Empty Buildable"          , "EM"  ,
  "Governmental"             , "GO"  ,
  "Group Quarters"           , "GQ"  ,
  "Healthcare"               , "HE"  ,
  "Industrial"               , "IN"  ,
  "Mixed Use"                , "MU"  ,
  "Multi Family Res"         , "MF"  ,
  "No Build"                 , "NB"  ,
  "Office"                   , "OF"  ,
  "Open Space Non-Buildable" , "OS"  ,
  "Other"                    , "OT"  ,
  "Retail"                   , "RE"  ,
  "Single Family Res"        , "SF"  ,
  "Utilities"                , "UT"
  # Note: NA values are handled in the join below
)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn, "bc_map", bc_mapping, overwrite = TRUE)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PARCELS: Attribute Join (Parcel ID Match)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("🏗️ Attaching Building Codes to Parcels (Attribute Match)...")

# Join Abbreviation to Parcels
# Note: QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() handles cases where a parcel has multiple buildings
# Note: We prioritize the LARGEST building on the parcel using building_sqft
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  ALTER TABLE targets_parcels ADD COLUMN BC VARCHAR;

  UPDATE targets_parcels
  SET BC = COALESCE(mapped.abbr, 'OT') -- Handle NA/Unknown as 'OT'
  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.parcel_id,
      m.abbr
    FROM points_buildings b
    JOIN bc_map m ON b.building_type = m.full_name

    -- Order by square footage descending to pick the main building
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.parcel_id
      ORDER BY b.building_sqft DESC
    ) = 1
  ) mapped
  WHERE targets_parcels.parcel_id = mapped.parcel_id
"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. H3: Hybrid Approach
#    Pass A: Building Aggregation (Handles small parcels / mixed use)
#    Pass B: Spatial Backfill (Handles large parcels / empty lots)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("🏗️ Aggregating Building Codes to H3 (Index Match)...")

# --- Pass A: Aggregation via Index Match (Existing Logic) ---
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue(
    "
  ALTER TABLE targets_h3 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS BC VARCHAR;

  UPDATE targets_h3
  SET BC = agg.mode_bc
  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.h3_index,
      MODE(COALESCE(m.abbr, 'OT')) as mode_bc
    FROM points_buildings b
    LEFT JOIN bc_map m ON b.building_type = m.full_name
    GROUP BY b.h3_index
  ) agg
  WHERE targets_h3.h3_index = agg.h3_index
"
  )
)

# --- Pass B: Spatial Backfill (Gap Filling) ---
# Check: If BC is still NULL, sample the Parcel Polygon at the H3 Center.
# This fixes large parcels where the H3 cell is far from the building centroid.

message("  ↳ Filling gaps using Parcel Polygons...")

# Update NULLs only
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  UPDATE targets_h3
  SET BC = matched.BC
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ph.h3_index,
      p.BC
    FROM points_h3 ph
    -- Spatial Join: H3 Center inside Parcel Polygon
    JOIN targets_parcels p ON ST_Intersects(ph.geom, p.geom)
    WHERE p.BC IS NOT NULL
  ) matched
  WHERE targets_h3.h3_index = matched.h3_index
    AND targets_h3.BC IS NULL -- Only touch rows that failed Pass A
"
)

# --- Pass C: Spatial Voting (KNN Mode) ---
# Logic: If a cell is empty, look at its 6 immediate neighbors.
# If 4 or more neighbors have data, we assume this is a "glitch" or hole -> FILL IT.
# If 3 or fewer neighbors have data, we assume this is a coastline/edge -> LEAVE IT.
message("  ↳ Pass C: Filling holes using Grid Adjacency (Threshold >= 4)...")

DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  UPDATE targets_h3
  SET BC = fill.mode_bc
  FROM (
    SELECT
      t.h3_index,
      MODE(n.BC) as mode_bc
    FROM targets_h3 t
    -- 1. Get the 6 immediate neighbors (k=1) for the empty cell
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT unnest(h3_grid_disk(t.h3_index, 1)) as neighbor_h3
    ) grid
    -- 2. Join back to the main table to check the neighbor's value
    JOIN targets_h3 n ON grid.neighbor_h3 = n.h3_index

    WHERE t.BC IS NULL          -- Target must be empty
      AND n.BC IS NOT NULL      -- Neighbor must have data
      AND t.h3_index != n.h3_index -- Exclude the cell itself

    GROUP BY t.h3_index
    -- 3. THE RULE: Only fill if surrounded by at least 4 valid cells
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
  ) fill
  WHERE targets_h3.h3_index = fill.h3_index
"
)

# --- Pass D: Final Cleanup (Catch-All) ---
# Logic: If it is STILL null after Pass C, it means it is either:
# 1. Genuinely empty (surrounded by < 4 valid neighbors)
# 2. A remote area with no data
# We force these to 'OT' (Other).
message("  ↳ Pass D: Setting remaining NULLs to 'OT'...")

DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  "
  UPDATE targets_h3
  SET BC = 'OT'
  WHERE BC IS NULL
"
)

# Cleanup
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "DROP TABLE points_buildings; DROP TABLE bc_map;")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-missing-b3
#| eval: false
# Check H3 for missing BC values
DBI::dbGetQuery(
  conn,
  "
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) as total,
    COUNT(BC) as filled,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(BC) as missing,
    ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) - COUNT(BC)) / COUNT(*), 2) as missing_pct
  FROM targets_h3
"
)

# Check Parcels (for comparison)
parcel_stats <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  conn,
  "
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) as total,
    COUNT(BC) as filled,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(BC) as missing,
    ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) - COUNT(BC)) / COUNT(*), 2) as missing_pct
  FROM targets_parcels
"
)
```

## Attach Job Access (AA, AT)

We attach the raw job access numbers from the TAZ layer. The normalization (dividing by city max) will happen in Step 4.

```{r}
#| label: func-job-join
fp_taz_access <- here::here(
  dirs$processed,
  "access",
  "TAZ_AccessToOpportunities_OY2023.parquet"
)

attach_job_access <- function(conn, target_table, point_table, key) {
  message(glue::glue("💼 Attaching Job Access to {target_table}..."))

  # 1. Load TAZ (already UTM)
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE taz_access AS
    SELECT
      ST_MakeValid(geometry) as geom,
      Job_byAuto,
      Job_byTran
    FROM read_parquet('{fp_taz_access}')
    WHERE ST_IsValid(geometry)
  "
    )
  )

  # 2. RESET COLUMNS (Drop if exists)
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS \"AA\"")
  )
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS \"AT\"")
  )

  # 3. Add Columns
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} ADD COLUMN \"AA\" DOUBLE")
  )
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue("ALTER TABLE {target_table} ADD COLUMN \"AT\" DOUBLE")
  )

  # 4. Spatial Join
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    glue::glue(
      "
    UPDATE {target_table}
    SET \"AA\" = match.Job_byAuto, \"AT\" = match.Job_byTran
    FROM (
      SELECT tp.{key}, MIN(t.Job_byAuto) as Job_byAuto, MIN(t.Job_byTran) as Job_byTran
      FROM {point_table} tp
      JOIN taz_access t ON ST_Intersects(tp.geom, t.geom)
      GROUP BY tp.{key}
    ) match
    WHERE {target_table}.{key} = match.{key};
  "
    )
  )

  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "DROP TABLE taz_access;")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-job-join
# Run with pre-calculated points
attach_job_access(conn, "targets_parcels", "points_parcels", "parcel_id")
attach_job_access(conn, "targets_h3", "points_h3", "h3_index")
```

# Part 3: Amenity Operations Engine

## Configuration

We define all external layers here. This structure handles Binary (In/Out), Isochrone (Time), and Buffer (Distance) logic.

```{r}
#| label: config-amenities
# Helpers
iso_walk <- function(f) here::here(dirs$isochrones, "foot-walking", f)
iso_bike <- function(f) here::here(dirs$isochrones, "cycling-regular", f)
iso_drive <- function(f) here::here(dirs$isochrones, "driving-car", f)
land_use <- function(f) here::here(sub_dirs$landuse, f)
trans <- function(f) here::here(sub_dirs$transport, f)
amen <- function(f) here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, f)

# OZ 2.0: the layer holds all 147 eligible tracts; GOEO recommends these 37
# (definitionExpression of the goeo.maps.arcgis.com "Utah Opportunity Zone Tract Recommendations" map)
oz_recommended_sql <- "geoid_tract IN (
  '49003960601', '49005000501', '49005000800', '49005001002', '49007000600', '49011125701',
  '49011125702', '49013940501', '49019000200', '49021110502', '49021110601', '49031960100',
  '49035102100', '49035102702', '49035102900', '49035111500', '49035111802', '49035112101',
  '49035112404', '49035112700', '49035113312', '49035113514', '49035113906', '49039972401',
  '49045130600', '49047968401', '49049000511', '49049001801', '49049001802', '49049001900',
  '49049002209', '49049002902', '49049980500', '49053271501', '49057201100', '49057201900',
  '49057210701'
)"

amenity_config <- tibble::tribble(
  ~col_name                                                                     , ~type                        , ~path                                                  , ~filter_sql                           , ~value_col , ~buffer_opts ,

  # --- BINARY ---
  "OZ"                                                                          , "binary"                     , land_use("Utah_Qualified_Opportunity_Zones.parquet")   , oz_recommended_sql                    , NA         , NA           ,
  "CM"                                                                          , "binary"                     , land_use("WCV_Centers_and_Regional_Land_Uses.parquet") , "center_type = 'Metropolitan Center'" , NA         , NA           ,
  "CU"                                                                          , "binary"                     , land_use("WCV_Centers_and_Regional_Land_Uses.parquet") , "center_type = 'Urban Center'"        , NA         , NA           ,
  "CC"                                                                          , "binary"                     , land_use("WCV_Centers_and_Regional_Land_Uses.parquet") , "center_type = 'City Center'"         , NA         , NA           ,
  "CN"                                                                          , "binary"                     , land_use("WCV_Centers_and_Regional_Land_Uses.parquet") , "center_type = 'Neighborhood Center'" , NA         , NA           ,

  # --- ISOCHRONES ---
  "TT_Local"                                                                    , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("Transit_Local.parquet")                      , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "TT_Rapid"                                                                    , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("Transit_Rapid.parquet")                      , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "TT_CRT"                                                                      , "isochrone"                  , iso_bike("Transit_CRT.parquet")                        , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "TF"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , iso_drive("Freeways.parquet")                          , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AC"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("ChildCare.parquet")                          , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AH"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , iso_drive("Healthcare.parquet")                        , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AG"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("Grocery.parquet")                            , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AM"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("Community_Centers.parquet")                  , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AE_K12"                                                                      , "isochrone"                  , iso_walk("Schools_PreK12.parquet")                     , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AE_High"                                                                     , "isochrone"                  , iso_bike("Schools_HigherEd.parquet")                   , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,
  "AP"                                                                          , "isochrone"                  , amen("ParkAccess_Graded.parquet")                      , "1=1"                                 , "value"    , NA           ,

  # --- BUFFER ---
  "TA_class1"                                                                   , "buffer"                     , trans("Bikeways.parquet")                              ,
  "facility1 LIKE '%(1A)%' OR facility1 LIKE '%(1B)%'"                          ,
  NA                                                                            , c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.5, 3.0) ,

  "TA_class2"                                                                   , "buffer"                     , trans("Bikeways.parquet")                              ,
  "facility1 LIKE '%(2A)%' OR facility1 LIKE '%(2B)%' OR facility1 LIKE '%2C%'" ,
  NA                                                                            , c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.5, 3.0) ,

  "TA_trails"                                                                   , "buffer"                     , trans("Bikeways.parquet")                              ,
  "facility1 LIKE '%Trail%'"                                                    ,
  NA                                                                            , c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.5, 3.0)
)
```

## Processing Function

The engine lives in `_src/process_amenities.R`. For each layer it joins every point to the
layer and keeps a small (id, value) result table; nothing is written back to the big
parcel/H3 tables until the single final join. Isochrone bands and buffer distances are matched
closest-first, so each wider band only tests the points no closer band has matched.

Each isochrone band is dissolved into a single geometry before the join. Benchmarked on this
data, joining the individual driving isochrones (hundreds of overlapping ~6,000-vertex polygons)
takes hours, while the dissolved band takes seconds and gives identical matches.
No indexes are created: DuckDB's spatial join builds its own.

### Check Inputs

Fail now, not after an hour, if a layer is missing:

```{r}
#| label: check-inputs
missing_layers <- amenity_config$path[!file.exists(amenity_config$path)]
if (length(missing_layers) > 0) {
  stop("Missing amenity layers:\n", paste(unique(missing_layers), collapse = "\n"))
}
```

### Spatial Join

We run every layer against both point tables, then join all results onto the targets at once.

```{r}
#| label: run-engine
message("🚀 Starting Processing on Points...")
t_total_start <- Sys.time()

config_list <- purrr::transpose(amenity_config)

for (cfg in config_list) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  process_layers(conn, "points_parcels", "parcel_id", cfg)
  process_layers(conn, "points_h3", "h3_index", cfg)
  message(glue::glue("   ⏱️ {cfg$col_name}: {round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'secs'))} s"))
}

join_amenities(conn, "targets_parcels", "points_parcels", "parcel_id", amenity_config)
join_amenities(conn, "targets_h3", "points_h3", "h3_index", amenity_config)

total_duration <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), t_total_start, units = "mins"), 2)
message(glue::glue("✅ Targets enriched. Total Time: {total_duration} mins."))
```

# Export

We export the "Wide" tables (ID + all amenity values, with the geometry as `geom`) in EPSG:26912.
DuckDB writes the CRS into the GeoParquet metadata because `geom` is a CRS-typed geometry.

```{r}
#| label: export
fp_out_parcels <- here::here(dirs$results, "parcels_enriched.parquet")
fp_out_h3 <- here::here(dirs$results, "h3_enriched.parquet")

DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue("COPY targets_parcels TO '{fp_out_parcels}' (FORMAT PARQUET)")
)
DBI::dbExecute(
  conn,
  glue::glue("COPY targets_h3 TO '{fp_out_h3}' (FORMAT PARQUET)")
)

message("🚀 Processing Complete!")
```

## Cleanup

```{r}
#| label: cleanup
DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)
# The database is in memory, so there is nothing to delete. DuckDB's spill files
# in .tmp/duckdb are removed automatically when the connection closes.
```
